---
title: "Pits"
---

Where pipes weaken, pits form.

In regulated banking environments, failure is often silent before it becomes visible:
- reconciliation breaks late,
- controls trigger after the fact,
- downstream consumers inherit corrupted meaning.

This section analyses **failure modes** that degrade regulatory reporting and AI-readiness:

- Schema drift and contract breaks  
- Semantic inconsistency across domains  
- Identity resolution / golden record gaps  
- Ownership ambiguity and control boundary failures  
- Monitoring blind spots (freshness, missingness, drift)
